author: Little Chinese Everywhere
description:
This video is a little different from my usual adventures. After months on the road, I'm finally back home in Hangzhou, and I thought it would be fun to show you what my life looks like when I'm not traveling across China.
Come spend a typical day with me, from my morning routine and favorite local spots to the quiet moments of everyday life. This is what "normal life" looks like between all the adventures 🎬
